# os-configdata — OpenStrata ConfigData Template

identity: OpenStrata.NET.ConfigData

Short name: os-configdata

Primary output: `ConfigData\\OstrataTemplate.1.ConfigData.csproj`

Description: Scaffolds a ConfigData project used to package data for import into Dataverse environments.

Parameters

- `ostrata-version`: (optional) default `1.*`

Usage example

```powershell
dotnet new os-configdata
```
